fixes.area: small casters lose their shadows at low sun (people, benches), 4th round; noon is fixed
fixes.problem: hero (el 8.9): the blue-jacket walker stands on sunlit pavers and casts nothing; there is no contact darkening at his shoes, so he reads pasted on. The player and the bench cast nothing either. hero_back: the 7.8 m lamp pole casts a clear streak across the plaza, but the bench 15 px from it and the walker at x 0.75 cast nothing. mends (el 11.9): rail posts cast, the player does not. hero_noon now shows all of them (player, walker, bench), so the mirror-pass fix worked and castShadow and the skinned bounds are fine. What fails is sun elevation or caster height under 2 m. By code reading: G.shadowRadius is 90 on high (game/index.js line 260), so ext is about 263 m and the texel is 0.13 m, enough for a 0.45 m body. The PCSS slope epsilon (pcss.js line 72: 0.6 * one texel of slope) grows to about 0.5 m of depth on grazing ground at el 9. That culls only the first 0.5 m from the feet, not the whole shadow, so it does not explain the rest. The remaining suspect is the shot harness. shoot.mjs waits 8000 ms at about 14 s/frame (shots.json ms 14391), so the screenshot can come before the first 'every 2' shadow update after clearView/teleport. Moved walkers then keep the stale map, which has no shadow at their new positions.
fixes.fix: (0) Diagnose with one frame each, cheapest first. (a) In tools/qa/shoot.mjs, after G.post?.resetAdaptation(), add G.shadows?.invalidate?.(3); G.renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate = true; and await two requestAnimationFrame ticks before page.screenshot. If walker shadows appear in hero, the cause was the harness. (b) Else run tools/qa/one.mjs hero with ?q=ultra (4096 map). If they appear there, it is resolution: on high, shrink the box while el < 15 (game/index.js line 260: 90 -> 60 when cur.el < 15; minUV 1.2 -> 0.8 texel, pcss.js line 79). (c) Else lower the slope epsilon 0.6 -> 0.35 (pcss.js line 72) and clamp slopeMax 6.0 -> 4.0 (line 64). Then check hero_back for acne on the grazing pavers. (1) Add a fallback in any case, which GTA also does on low tiers: one InstancedMesh of sun-aligned contact quads under every visible character, using a radial-to-linear alpha texture. Length clamp(1.7/tan(el), 0.6, 5.0) m, width 0.55 m. Opacity 0.38 at the feet, falling to 0 at the tip, scaled by (1 - uNight) * smoothstep(-1, 4, el). At night use a round 1.0 m blob at 0.22. Yaw = atan2(-sunDir.x, -sunDir.z). One draw call total; update the matrices in peds.update and player.updateOnFoot.

fixes.problem: Visible walkers r6 -> r7: hero 6 -> 4, hero_back 5 -> 3, phone_hud 2 -> 1. The corridor works, but peds.js S.clearView (line 64) sends every walker within 2.5 m of the sightline, or within 3 m of the player, to ANY waypoint on its loop more than 18 m away. That is usually far off-screen on a 1 km loop, so the frame thins out. hero_back now reads as a quiet weekday at 18:15 on a summer evening at EQ.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.clearView: choose relocation waypoints inside the view. Keep only waypoints w with 10 < |w - cam| < 60 m, dot(normalize(w - cam), camFwd) > 0.5, distance to the cam->player+2m segment > 3.0 m, and distance to the player > 4 m. If none, fall back to the current rule. After clearing, top up: move walkers from the eq/landing loops that are out of view (dot < 0) onto such waypoints until 7 walkers are inside the cone on high (3 on low). Give each a random walk phase (ch.mixer.setTime(random*1.2)) so they are not in lock-step.

fixes.area: clone crowd + idle walker standing in the bench
fixes.problem: hero_noon and hero_night each show three identical green-top/jeans women in one frame, plus two of them in hero. pool (peds.js line 31) holds 10 avatars for about 90 walkers, picked round-robin with no tint variation, and IDLE_SPOTS photo idlers reuse FEMALE[(i%4)+1] (line 59). hero_noon: the idle woman stands inside the bench footprint, with her legs showing through between the seat and the backrest. IDLE_SPOTS are inset 2.2 m from SHORE_N, while benches sit at inset 3.5 m and 2 m along from every second lamp (props.js line 207), so the two overlap whenever the along-shore positions coincide.
fixes.fix: (1) peds.js pick(): reject an avatar if another walker with the same avatar is within 30 m of the spawn point (max 6 tries). (2) Per-instance clothing variation: in avatars.instance(), clone every non-head, non-hair material and multiply its colour by an HSL offset (hue +-0.08, sat x[0.7,1.2], light x[0.75,1.15]), seeded by the instance index. This adds no draw calls or programs. (3) IDLE_SPOTS: inset 2.2 -> 1.1 m, so idlers lean on the coping facing the water, and drop any spot within 1.8 m of a bench (export benchM positions from props.js, or recompute alongShore(SHORE_N,-110,330,17,3.5) offsets).

fixes.area: night towers: uniform beige mosaic from the far-room average and grey emissive blinds
fixes.problem: hero_night: the left tower is a uniform beige-grey checker from top to bottom, with no dark floors and no warm windows. The right tower shows tan bands with grey slabs between them. In facade.js line 192, the far-room average roomAvg = 0.04 + (0.06+0.3*uNight)*lampC is the same for every cell, and line 193 blends it in over farRoom, which is 1 at about 200 m. Every distant window therefore glows the same mean beige, whether lit or not. Line 191 draws blinds as an EMISSIVE grey (0.30 * 0.45 lit / * 0.18 unlit), which produces the grey slabs. Line 170 still uses 6-bay zones.
fixes.fix: facade.js: line 192-193, keep the lit/unlit choice in the average: roomAvg = lit > 0.5 ? lampC*(0.08 + 0.42*uNight) : vec3(0.010, 0.011, 0.014). Line 191, blinds: lit > 0.5 ? lampC*mix(0.24, 0.32, uNight) : vec3(0.30)*mix(0.18, 0.02, uNight), so drawn blinds glow warm or go dark. Line 170: zone width floor(cell.x/6.0) -> floor(cell.x/(3.0+5.0*fcH(vec2(cell.y,seed)))), plus +0.18*fcH(vec2(cell.y*0.37, seed)) inside the step so whole floors switch together. Threshold 0.94-0.38*uNight -> 0.94-0.30*uNight, about 35% lit.

fixes.area: ghosted far skyline (facade constants landed; no change, so the cause is elsewhere)
fixes.problem: mends: the skyline is 152,148,154 against sky at 176,170,171 (dL 23; r6 had 152,150,158). kings_park: the CBD is 129,123,131 against 164,154,160 (dL 30). facade.js far frame 0.42 -> 0.30 (line 106), avgGlass raised (line 148) and far glass x0.68 (line 154) all landed and moved nothing. The remaining candidates are atmosInscatter, which is scaled by uSunColor = sun.color*11.8 (atmos.js line 48, so with sunInscatter 0.85 a 14-30% extinction returns near-sky radiance), and the post exposure adapting on the bright sky and water. fixes.fix: Run tools/qa/one.mjs mends three times, with ?vol=0, ?post=0 and an art override fog.sunInscatter=0, and measure the same box. Whichever drops dL by more than 10 is the cause. Expected: inscatter. Then set art.js fog.sunInscatter 0.85 -> 0.5 and fog.scatter [0.90,0.62,0.48] -> [0.70,0.58,0.52]; daycycle K fogSc at el 8 [0.88,0.64,0.50] -> [0.72,0.60,0.54] and at el 20 [0.74,0.74,0.76] -> [0.60,0.64,0.70]. Keep sigma. If dL is still under 35, cap atmosInscatter at 0.85x the sky radiance along the same ray (atmos.glsl.js atmosApply), so geometry can never be lighter than the sky behind it.
